# MaatwerkKunststof.nl

> Dutch specialist in custom plastic parts for companies and private customers, from one piece to recurring series. More than 8 years of experience, more than 1,000 unique plastic parts delivered and more than 15 technical plastics available from stock.

MaatwerkKunststof.nl supplies sawn and fully machined plastic blocks, strips, plates, rings, washers, bushes, spacers, wear parts, guides, replacement parts and other custom two-dimensional or three-dimensional components. Advice about materials and manufacturability is free and without obligation.

## Main pages

- [Home and custom plastic overview](https://maatwerkkunststof.nl/): Services, machining, applications, materials and quotation information.
- [Plastic blocks made to measure](https://maatwerkkunststof.nl/kunststof-blokken-op-maat/): Blocks, spacers, support blocks, wear blocks and machined block parts.
- [Plastic strips](https://maatwerkkunststof.nl/kunststof-stroken/): Flat strips, guides, wear strips and long narrow parts.
- [Plastic plates made to measure](https://maatwerkkunststof.nl/kunststof-platen-op-maat/): Sawn plates, flat contour parts and CNC-machined plate components.
- [Plastic rings made to measure](https://maatwerkkunststof.nl/kunststof-ringen-op-maat/): Rings, washers, flanged rings and special ring profiles.
- [Plastic discs made to measure](https://maatwerkkunststof.nl/kunststof-schijven-op-maat/): Solid discs, round plates and discs with bores, grooves or other machining.
- [Plastic gaskets made to measure](https://maatwerkkunststof.nl/kunststof-pakkingen/): Flat plastic gaskets in PTFE and other technical plastics, with holes, passages and free contours.

- [Mica gaskets made to measure](https://maatwerkkunststof.nl/mica-pakkingen/): Mica and micaliet gaskets, rings and custom contours, from one piece.

- [Rubber support blocks made to measure](https://maatwerkkunststof.nl/rubber-steunblokken/): Rubber blocks with mounting holes, recesses and custom shapes, from one piece.

## Material guides

- [HDPE made to measure](https://maatwerkkunststof.nl/hdpe-op-maat/): HDPE properties, variants, products, machining and price factors.
- [POM made to measure](https://maatwerkkunststof.nl/pom-op-maat/): POM properties, applications, precision parts and machining.
- [PTFE made to measure](https://maatwerkkunststof.nl/ptfe-op-maat/): PTFE properties, rings, strips, chemical applications and machining.
- [PU made to measure](https://maatwerkkunststof.nl/pu-op-maat/): Polyurethane hardnesses, wear parts, damping parts and machining.
- [PVC made to measure](https://maatwerkkunststof.nl/pvc-op-maat/): Rigid PVC grades, blocks, plates, rings, machining, bonding, welding and price factors.
